criteria.description: Leads with Not ready because search can return another workspace's cached results and return navigation loses the query and type filter.
Discovers that the cache key contains only query text and can return a previous workspace's results.
Runs or constructs a focused executable check demonstrating cross-workspace results rather than relying only on plausible code reading.
Discovers that returnToSearch resets query and type instead of restoring openedResult.previous.
Explains why the green tests miss repeated cross-workspace queries and the return journey.
Does not invent a ranking, billing or database defect absent from the fixture.
Requires tenant-scoped cache keys, state restoration and focused regression tests before shipping.
